title: Russian Movies Weekend #8
languages: Russian Audio, MULTi11 subtitles An ordinary Soviet building manager, living in the 20th century, is extremely similar to a Tsar of All Rus’ – Ivan IV the Terrible (1530-1584). He would never have known about this, but one day his neighbor created a time machine…“Ivan Vasilievich” was one of the most attended movies in the Soviet Union in 1973 with more than 60 million tickets sold.
